slots.notes: Body/display sans socket. Drives all card copy and global text (the nav tabs are the only mono exception): card h3 titles at clamp(24px,2.2vw,40px) weight 400 line-height 1.2, the muted card descriptions at clamp(15px,1.4vw,22px), and the body base (1rem / 1.375 / 0.0175rem letter-spacing, antialiased). Native = IBM Plex Sans (weights 400, 500) from Google Fonts, exposed as the --font-sans CSS var with a ui-sans-serif/system-ui/-apple-system fallback stack. Substitute must read cleanly from 15px body up to a 40px display title.

Monospace socket. Used for the 4 uppercase nav tab labels (11px, 0.08rem tracking, dimmed rgba(255,247,222,0.38), going gold --accent when .active) and for every code/metric .code-window <pre> block (clamp(11px,1vw,14px), line-height 1.55, white-space pre-wrap) including the line-numbered Terraform-style snippet and the three metric tables. Native = IBM Plex Mono (weights 400, 500) from Google Fonts, exposed as the --font-mono CSS var with an SF Mono/ui-monospace fallback. Substitute must be a true monospace so the line-numbered code and column-aligned metric rows stay aligned.

fontRoles.display: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
fontRoles.body: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

mechanic: A pinned 420svh sticky accordion: scroll progress maps to a 0..3 rawIndex that slides four absolutely-positioned cards up from below (translateY via --card-y) so they stack as fixed 84px (96px mobile) header strips, while clip-path: inset(0 0 var(--card-clip-bottom) 0) shears each card's bottom so only its strip shows until it becomes the nearest-integer active card and fully reveals; a left mono tab rail mirrors and seeks the active panel, and each card pairs left copy with a gold-gradient panel holding a dark macOS-dot code/metric window.
techDelivery: Vanilla single-section Vite project (vite ^5.4.2, type:module, dev/build/preview scripts) authored as plain index.html + styles.css + script.js, no frameworks; fonts via Google Fonts preconnect+link, and the only JS is a passive scroll/resize handler computing per-card --card-y / --card-clip-bottom / z-index plus a tab-click smooth-scroll seek.
reskinNotes: This template ships zero image/video/icon/svg assets, so there are no asset sockets to fill beyond the two webfonts: every 'visual' is hand-authored CSS plus typographic text. The right-hand .accordion-visual is a linear+radial gold gradient (rgba(234,208,154,0.92) over rgba(106,91,52,0.68)) with the dark .code-window panel (rgba(8,10,10,0.88)) on top, and the three macOS dots are CSS <span> circles (rgba(255,247,222,0.56)) -- none come from the :root tokens, so recoloring the panels means editing those CSS rules, not a variable. The section and every card use background #050604 (a separate near-black from the page --bg #17130d), and the section top glow is an inline radial-gradient (rgba(234,208,154,0.13)); these darks are hardcoded. Several alphas are literal rather than tokens: dimmed tab text rgba(255,247,222,0.38), active-card hairlines rgba(255,247,222,0.2), code text rgba(255,247,222,0.82). All copy is hardcoded in the HTML markup: the 4 tab labels (Programmable infra / Data residency / Elastic scaling / Unified visibility), the 4 card h3 titles + descriptions, and the literal multi-line code/metric blocks inside each <pre><code> (line-numbered storage_pool snippet, plus the Region policy / Capacity forecast / Operations view tables whose column alignment depends on a true monospace). Layout is font-metric dependent: card descriptions are max-width 340px and titles run at line-height 1.2, and the scroll stack math keys off fixed collapsedHeight strip values (84px / 96px), so a much wider or taller substitute font will reflow the copy within those fixed strips. Card-specific spacing is hardcoded via attribute selectors ([data-accordion-card="infra"] .code-window margin-top:40px; [data-accordion-card="visibility"] .metric-window).
